'''Pipe Splitter''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 pipeline into multiple pipelines (up to 3).|A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.}}
==Usage==
A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 pipeline into multiple pipelines (up to 3).

Pipe Splitters can split 1 pipeline into 2 or 3 pipelines to divide fluid flow.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC I - Pipe Fittings]]
